import asyncio
import os
import urllib3
from alembic.config import Config
from alembic.script import ScriptDirectory
from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine
from minio import Minio

async def check_schema():
    heads = set(ScriptDirectory.from_config(Config('/app/alembic.ini')).get_heads())
    if not heads:
        raise RuntimeError('No Alembic migration head in backend image')
    engine = create_async_engine(os.environ['DATABASE_URL'], pool_pre_ping=True)
    try:
        async with engine.connect() as db:
            version_table = (await db.execute(text("SELECT to_regclass('public.alembic_version')"))).scalar()
            if version_table is None:
                raise RuntimeError('Schema not initialized: alembic_version missing. Do not run automatic migrations on an unverified PVC.')
            installed = set((await db.execute(text('SELECT version_num FROM public.alembic_version'))).scalars().all())
    finally:
        await engine.dispose()
    if installed != heads:
        raise RuntimeError('Database Alembic revisions do not match application. Run an approved, backed-up migration first.')
    print('Database schema matches pinned backend migration heads')

asyncio.run(check_schema())
ca = os.environ.get('MINIO_CA_CERT_PATH', '/service-ca/service-ca.crt')
if not os.path.isfile(ca):
    raise RuntimeError('OpenShift service-CA certificate unavailable')
pool = urllib3.PoolManager(cert_reqs='CERT_REQUIRED', ca_certs=ca)
client = Minio(
    os.environ['MINIO_ENDPOINT'],
    access_key=os.environ['MINIO_ACCESS_KEY'],
    secret_key=os.environ['MINIO_SECRET_KEY'],
    secure=True,
    http_client=pool,
)
bucket = os.environ['MINIO_BUCKET_RAW']
if not client.bucket_exists(bucket):
    raise RuntimeError('Required bucket not present: ' + bucket + '. Provision only through an authorized S3 admin.')
print('Required S3 bucket exists; runtime preconditions passed')
